messages: I hear that #b#p226##k the Security Guy made up his mind about something...

I met with #p226# at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then was completely gone... because he and his mom drank it all... Ah, well. #p226# said he was over the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, #p504# of #m10004000# is asking for #b1 #t4031033##k, #b10 #t4010105#s#k, #b30 #t4000036#s#k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b20 #t4003000#s#k! He wants me to gather them for him... The fairies of #m10002000# might know something about the #t4031033#.

I brought #p226# the materials he needed to make the gloves and received his treasured heirloom helmet, #b#t1002165##k, in return. It felt like I got the short end of the deal... but since it's a family heirloom, passed down for generations, I couldn't really complain...
name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
